import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()

        # Branch 1
        self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        )

        # Branch 2
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        )

        # Branch 3
        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        )

        # Concatenate the branches
        self.concat_layer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(32, 32, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32)
        )

        # Fully connected layers
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features='mask', out_features=128)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # the initial shape of x is: (1, 1, 28, 28)
        branch1 = self.branch1(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 32, 14, 14)
        branch2 = self.branch2(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 32, 14, 14)
        branch3 = self.branch3(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 32, 14, 14)

        concatenated = torch.cat((branch1, branch2, branch3), dim=1)  # output tensor shape: (1, 96, 14, 14)
        
        flattened = torch.flatten(concatenated, 1)  # output tensor shape: (1, 18816)
        
        output = self.fc1(flattened)
        output = torch.relu(output)
        output = self.fc2(output)
        output = torch.sigmoid(output)

        return output


if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = DL_Model()
    input_tensor = torch.randn(1, 1, 28, 28)  # Batch size 1, 1 channel, 28x28 image
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)
    print(output_tensor.shape)
